evidence: A decade-long user is very happy with YubiKeys after choosing hardware independent of their computer vendor and movable between locations.

evidence_sources.author: jwr
evidence_sources.excerpt: I decided years ago that I want to protect my keys with a hardware device that is independent of the vendor of the machine that I'm currently using. I also want to have backup keys and I want to be able to freely move them around various physical locations. Or have a backup shipped to me across the world if necessary. YubiKeys were the only solution that fit these requirements, so I went with those. I have been using them for the last ten years or so and I've been very happy with this solution.

source_story_title: Protecting SSH Keys with macOS Secure Enclave
